about: The closed set of fixed text an agent tool result may hold, read by core/src/harness/fixed.ts and by the native agent_step check (see README.md). Every string in a tool envelope is one of: a value below, a placeholder label, an ISO 8601 time or date, or (only under sentence_keys) a sentence of sentence_words. Numbers are non-negative safe integers; booleans are allowed; null never is.

system_message.policy: policy.txt with its final line break removed
system_message.title: the skill file's title: frontmatter value, trimmed
system_message.body: everything after the skill file's closing --- fence line, trimmed

procedure_prompt: Run this procedure now. Answer only with the JSON object.

labels.pattern: [<family> <n>], n from 1 to 9999 with no leading zero

time_patterns.datetime: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, optionally :SS and .sss, then Z or +HH:MM or -HH:MM

values: a message says it is cancelled while the calendar still shows it
a message says the room is unavailable while the calendar still lists it
a part of the check Ozzie can't describe
a schedule fact for a person to look at; about care, not performance
an unanswered request elsewhere at this time
confirmed people counted; ages not checked
draft only; nothing has been sent
fewer confirmed than the church rules ask
in no particular order, not ranked

not contacted, according to the message
not listed for an open need of this role
not needed; the last check is current

ids.about: Under these keys and nowhere else, a string is an id: the key's prefix then n, n from 1 to 9999 with no leading zero (f3, d1). Every row of a tool result that states a fact has a fact id, unique within one task; a prepared draft has a draft id. A final answer refers to them.

answer.about: The model's final reply (a reply with no tool calls) is only a JSON object, optionally inside one code fence (a first line of ``` or ```json and a last line of ```), with whitespace around it: {"answer":<kind>} plus "facts" (a list of distinct fact ids, at most max_facts; required and non-empty for facts) and "draft" (a draft id; required for draft and allowed only there). No other key, no repeated key. Every id must be one a tool result in this task holds.

sentence_characters: ASCII letters and digits, space, line feed, and . , ; : ? ! ' ( ) -
sentence_tokens: after labels and ISO times are set aside: words are runs of ASCII letters with inner apostrophes (it's, didn't), compared in lower case; digit runs are counts
